Name: Weapon Renderer
Author: MGLXI
Description:
[size=6][b]Weapon Renderer[/b][/size]

A framework that renders weapon sprites at their native size during attacks. Stardew Valley forces all weapon sprites to 16x16 during the swing animation; this framework intercepts that rendering and draws the full sprite at its real size.

[b]This mod does not add any weapons by itself.[/b] You need content packs that depend on it.

[line]

[size=5][b]What does it do?[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Renders attack sprites at their native size (24x24, 32x32, 48x48....), without cropping or rescaling.[/*]
[*]Allows creating new weapons with custom stats.[/*]
[*]Allows overriding the attack sprite of vanilla weapons without changing their icons or stats.[/*]
[*]Supports translations in all 12 official game languages.[/*]
[*]Per-weapon adjustment of pivot, rotation, offsets, and hitbox.[/*]
[*]Public API for other mods to register weapons dynamically.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+.[/*]
[*]Extract the ZIP into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/font].[/*]
[*]Install compatible content packs.[/*]
[/list]
If you want to edit the global configuration in-game, also install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] (optional).

[line]

[size=5][b]For players[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Weapons appear in Marlon's shop if the content pack configures it that way.[/*]
[*]Console commands:
[list]
[*][font=Courier New]wr_reload[/font] — reloads the config without restarting the game.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New]wr_show[/font] — prints the current values.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]For modders[/b][/size]

The full guide to creating content packs (folder structure, reference of every [font=Courier New]weapon.json[/font] field, pivot and hitbox formulas, vanilla weapon override mode, translations, and public API) is included in the [b]README.md[/b] inside the ZIP.

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] 4.0+ — required[/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] — optional[/*]
[/list]
[line]
